name: Spectrum
statusNote: v0.1.0, live and running. Milestones M0–M5 done, including a post-handoff dedupe fix; semantic (non-title-string) dedupe is a known remaining gap.
oneLiner: A unified Rust news-monitoring engine that replaced three predecessor engines — it pools 34 feeds, has a local LLM sort each headline into one of four bands with a severity score, and posts themed cards to Discord, with a Tauri desktop control panel on top.
stack: Rust 2021, Cargo workspace, GNU toolchain only
reqwest on native-tls to keep the dependency tree C-free

components.name: crates/engine
components.desc: The core pipeline: 34-source feed pool, RSS fetch, one-call-per-headline Ollama classification, per-category embed skins, Discord posting, capped dedupe store

components.name: engine.rs
components.desc: The Engine orchestrator: seed, poll, drip, status, recent log, live config reload

components.name: analyze.rs
components.desc: Single Ollama call per headline, fail-safe coerced to a category enum, defaulting to Drop

components.name: crates/headless
components.desc: Thin CLI runner around the same engine

components.name: src-tauri
components.desc: Desktop shell: a background thread owns one Engine, seven Tauri commands, live tuning writes, system tray, single-instance guard

components.name: ui/
components.desc: Vanilla dark cockpit panel polling the Tauri commands every 2 seconds

dataFlow: 34 RSS and Google News feeds are fetched, merged, and deduped.
The first run seeds the seen-store and posts nothing; subsequent polls only look at unseen items.
Each unseen headline gets exactly one local Ollama classification and is marked seen regardless of outcome.
Items that clear the category and severity gates enter an in-memory priority queue.
The drip step pops the strongest items first, skins them per category, and posts embed cards to the matching Discord channel — or logs a dry-run preview.
The background thread publishes status and a recent log, which the desktop panel polls every 2 seconds.
Tuning saved in the UI rewrites the local config and reloads on the next loop.
integrations: 34 RSS / Google News feeds (no API keys)
decisions: One pipeline replaced three separate engines; the predecessors were archived as superseded.
One LLM read per unique headline, never re-classified — a non-negotiable constraint.
Local LLM only; no cloud model, no API keys anywhere in the feed pool.
GNU Rust toolchain with a C-free dependency tree — reqwest forced onto native-tls to avoid a C compiler.
Restart loses the in-memory drip queue — an accepted V1 trade-off.
Vanilla UI with withGlobalTauri, mirroring the house Tauri pattern; a React swap is a documented future option.
